title: ao.integration-module/v1 — the integration-module manifest (frozen, issue #646)
description: The shape of `integrations/<module>/module.yaml`, applied to the YAML parsed as JSON. Frozen because the manifest is what a reviewer, the indexer registration and every later child lane read: the three facts that make the module a module — `mandatory`, the feature flag's `off` default, and `data_source: indexer` — are CONSTRAINED by this schema rather than trusted to prose, so a manifest that stops declaring them stops validating. Every object is closed (`additionalProperties: false`): a new key is a schema change, reviewed as one. Validated by the repository's stdlib subset validator (`governance/modules/schema.py`), which refuses to load a schema using a keyword it cannot enforce — an unenforced keyword would be a requirement nobody measures.

id.description: The module id (also its directory name under integrations/).

mandatory.description: Admission: this module is part of the product, not an optional add-on. `false` is not an accepted value — a non-mandatory module is a different declaration and does not belong in this shape.

data_source.description: Every datum the module carries is served by governance/knowledge/. There is no second value: a module that reads its domain knowledge from its own files is exactly what this module must not become.

epic.description: The epic the module is built under.

issue.description: The issue that stood the module up.

features.description: The module's own feature flags. Every one defaults OFF (GR-5), and a flag that defaults ON cannot validate: the enum admits only the two spellings of OFF, because YAML reads an unquoted `off` as the boolean false (the same pair scripts/check-feature-flags.py accepts).

default.description: OFF: the string `off`, or the boolean YAML reads for an unquoted `off`. Nothing else — `on`, `true` and `"true"` are all refused.

catalogue.description: Pointers to the module's single store of domain facts. Each must resolve.

indexer_sources.description: The knowledge-index sources that serve this module. Each glob must be registered verbatim in governance/knowledge/sources.py.

kind.description: A kind from the indexer's closed vocabulary (governance/knowledge/model.py KINDS).

provenance.description: The GR-10 provenance declaration. Every catalogue file must carry the same one.

pattern_source_only.description: Upstream is read for patterns, never copied as code.

code_copied.description: No upstream code is copied into this repository.
